subject: Turning customer needs into a practical design
hook: A free design consultation that starts with how you live.
gbp:
Not sure exactly what you need? That's what our design consultation is for.

SUPERIO designs bespoke, made-to-measure furniture around how you actually use a room: kitchens, fitted wardrobes, media walls, home offices, alcove units, utility rooms and more. Every project starts with a conversation, not a catalogue.

How it works:
- A free, no-obligation design consultation to talk through what isn't working and what you need to store
- Measuring of the room, including sockets, radiators and uneven walls
- A design you can review and change before anything is made
- An itemised quote with transparent pricing and no hidden costs
- Manufacture in our own workshop in Hanley, quality-checked before it leaves
- Delivery and installation by our own team

We work with homeowners in Stone and across Stoke-on-Trent and Staffordshire. Bring photos you like and a list of niggles. Tap Learn more to arrange your consultation.
cta: Learn more and arrange a free consultation
